mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 27 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park under a full moon.

Regarding city taxes, property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15. You can pay in two installments, with the first due January 31, using the drop boxes at the City Center or paying online.
There are currently no events scheduled for the next 30 days, so we have a calm period ahead for our community calendar.
In a report covering November 1 through 15, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on November 2, resulting in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
